messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 49(3)

Article 49 Confidentiality. 3. Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings, nor shall it affect the obligations of the persons concerned to provide information under criminal law.

response.text:
Paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 49 | doNotAffect | rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies regarding exchange of information and dissemination of warnings | | shall not affect the rights and obligations of the Commission, Member States and notified bodies with regard to the exchange of information and the dissemination of warnings
Paragraphs 1 and 2 of Article 49 | doNotAffect | obligations of persons concerned to provide information under criminal law | | nor shall it affect the obligations of the persons concerned to provide information under criminal law
